_doc: RoboPaint xingshu (行书 臨帖) targets. singles: [slug, character, structure (single | left-right | top-bottom | enclosure)] (difficulty hard); works: [slug, characters] (difficulty extreme; no repeated character; the kaishu layout: two columns read right to left, top to bottom, one 96 mm box per character, 12 mm gaps). Each task's exemplar is its own graphics.txt-format file (--graphics <slug>.graphics.txt: one JSON line per character, "strokes" = the regions of its ink, Make Me a Hanzi em coordinates); the contact limit is --max-strokes (default: the number of regions). sources: the README's SOURCES text per slug ("*" = the default for every slug without its own entry); it is checked by checks/check-robopaint-leak.sh like every README sentence (e.g. write 'hand copy', not 'tracing copy'). Since 2026-10-08 (owner) eight targets (docs/benchmarks/robopaint.md, Targets).

sources.*: Wikimedia Commons, File:神龍蘭亭序全.JPG (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E7%A5%9E%E9%BE%8D%E8%98%AD%E4%BA%AD%E5%BA%8F%E5%85%A8.JPG): the Shenlong hand copy (馮承素, attributed, Tang, c. 627-650, ink on paper, Palace Museum, Beijing) of Wang Xizhi's 蘭亭序 (running script, c. 353). Licence on the file page: {{PD-Art|PD-old-100-1923|deathyear=672}} (public domain). The characters were cropped from this scan (downloaded unmodified on 2026-09-28), binarised and placed on the sheet; the scroll writes 脩 for 修.
